messages.subject: AHM companion Web Site
parts:
Dear Marc Kéry and Andrew Royle,

I've aquired recently AHM book vol1.
Congratulations for the great work and thank you for this novel source of learning for us all.
I am trying to start the exercises, but I can't find the companion web site.
When I type "http://www.mbr-pwrc.usgs.gov/pubanalysis/keryroylebook/", I am directed to a picture of the book's cover and an advertisement (short and discrete) to buy it from Amazon.
I even looked in USGS and PWRG pages and couldn't find a link to data, scripts and packages.

Thank you.
Best regards,
Thiago Timo.

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: RE: AHM companion Web Site
parts:
Dear Thiago, dear list,

we now have a basic AHM book website up and running:

www.mbr-pwrc.usgs.gov/pubanalysis/keryroylebook/

You find everything that you need in terms of Supplementary Materials for volume 1 of the Applied Hierarchical Modeling in Ecology book:
- a skeleton R package with all the functions (skeleton because only very few of them have a help file at current)
- 4 additional data sets that are need in chapters 6, 9, 10 and 11
- a text file that contains the entire R and BUGS code in the book.
- a link to another Google website for the book, where there is a list of errors

Kind regards  --  Marc & Andy


______________________________________________________________
